title: Zesty Irish Lentils Bake
description: A hearty and comforting one-pan dish featuring marinated Puy lentils, onions, garlic, and a blend of Irish-inspired spices.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the Puy lentils, chopped carrots, onions, minced garlic, and a pinch of salt. Rinse with cold water, then drain well and shake off excess water.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the melted butter, allspice, thyme, salt, and black pepper.
Add the Irish mustard to the bowl with the spice mixture and whisk until smooth.
Pour the marinade over the lentil mixture and toss to coat evenly.
Transfer the lentils and marinade to a 20x30cm (8x12 inch) baking dish and cover with foil.
Bake for 45 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5-10 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
Adjust seasoning as needed before serving.
